column1:
Showers or thundershowers are likely at a few places in the sea areas off the coast extending from
Chilaw to Hambantota via Colombo, Galle and Matara.

Winds will be south-westerly or variable in direction. Wind speed will be (20-30) kmph. Wind speed
can increase up to 40 kmph at times in the sea areas off the coast extending from Galle to Pottuvil via
Matara and Hambantota.

The sea areas off the coast extending from Galle to Pottuvil via Matara and Hambantota may be fairly
rough at times. The other sea areas around the island will be slight.
Temporarily strong gusty winds and very rough seas can be expected during thundershowers.
